title: Undo (Input Box)
body:
Hello, good day or evening.

I did briefly look through the issues for this and I didn't find anything exactly matching, so please forgive if this is a duplicate issue and handle accordingly.  

I was surprised to find the after typing in the incredible multi-line supported TUI input that a simple undo shortcut wouldn't even revert a paste.  

I suspect the control is using some sort of memory buffer mapped to its rendering but nevertheless, this would be a very essential and useful feature to have.  

Thank you very much. 

I wish you such a wonderful day!
🤍🙏🏼🌹🪽✨
author: light-merlin-dark
